tools.crops_around_the_mask_redraws_it: Crops around the mask, redraws it enlarged to the generation size, then pastes it back. Small parts like fingers come out sharper.
tools.default_95_ignored_when_lossless_i: Default 95. Ignored when lossless is on.
tools.drop_png_webp_jpeg_or_zip: Drop PNG, WebP, JPEG or ZIP files here, or choose images in the gallery and press "Send to image tools".

tools.inpaint_needs_an_image_made_with: Inpaint needs an image made with Asset Studio (with a record).
tools.inpaint_queued_the_result_is_added: Inpaint queued. The result is added to the end of the list.
tools.keeps_the_comfyui_prompt_and_workf: Keeps the ComfyUI prompt and workflow in the WebP EXIF. Turn off for files you share.
tools.no_mask_paint_the_area_to: No mask · paint the area to redraw with the brush.
tools.no_mask_split_the_background_or: No mask · split the background or paint the part to keep.
tools.not_analyzed_yet_run_it_from: Not analyzed yet. Run it from "Tagging" on the right.
tools.of_these_images_already_have_a: {0} of these images already have a mask; detection will replace it. Continue?
tools.off_default_removes_the_prompt_wor: Off (default) removes the prompt, workflow and EXIF.
tools.only_images_made_with_asset_studio: Only images made with Asset Studio. It redraws with that image's model, LoRAs and prompt. Faces may change, so check the result.
tools.only_the_green_area_is_redrawn: Only the green area is redrawn; the rest stays as it is. Paint it, then save.
tools.processed_in_order_face_eyes_mouth: Processed in order: face → eyes → mouth → hands.
tools.queued_images_for_post_processing_: Queued {0} images for post-processing. Results are added at the end of the list.
tools.redraws_with_the_image_s_own: Redraws with the image's own model and LoRAs. Unpainted areas keep the original pixels.
tools.remove_images_from_the_list_upload: Remove {0} images from the list? Uploaded copies are deleted; gallery originals stay.
tools.resized_at_the_end_if_it: Resized at the end if it differs from the model's scale.
tools.results_of_work_images_work_charac: Results of work images (work/character/outfit folders) are saved next to the source as new candidates; pass one in the gallery to adopt it. Other images are saved to outputs/_tools/.
tools.saves_a_new_png_with_only: Saves a new PNG with only the background made transparent; colors stay as they were.
tools.separate_with_commas_they_are_left: Separate with commas. They are left out of the panel, copies and exports.
tools.shares_the_generation_queue_so_it: Shares the generation queue, so it runs after the current image. Results are compared with the prompt in the middle panel.
tools.starts_from_the_image_s_recorded: Starts from the image's recorded prompt. Try adding tags that describe the fix.
tools.tags_in_the_prompt_that_the: Tags in the prompt that the tagger did not read. They may not be drawn, or the tagger may not know them.
tools.tags_in_the_prompt_that_were: Tags in the prompt that were also read in the image
tools.tags_the_tagger_read_in_the: Tags the tagger read in the image that the prompt does not have
tools.the_blue_area_stays_and_the: The blue area stays and the rest becomes transparent. Add with the brush, trim with the eraser, then save.
tools.the_original_stays_the_covered_ima: The original stays; the covered image is saved as a new PNG.
tools.the_red_area_gets_covered_widen: The red area gets covered. Widen it with the brush, trim it with the eraser, then save.
tools.there_are_unsaved_mask_edits_disca: There are unsaved mask edits. Discard them?
tools.txt_packs_one_caption_file_per: TXT packs one caption file per image, named like the image ZIP, so both can be extracted together for LoRA training.
tools.upload_images_or_send_them_from: Upload images or send them from the gallery to read metadata and tags, post-process and convert to WebP.
tools.uploads_are_off_on_the_preview: Uploads are off on the preview server.
tools.upscaling_removes_transparency_alp: Upscaling removes transparency (alpha). If you need a transparent background, run background removal after upscaling.
tools.you_can_also_paint_in_the: You can also paint in the middle without detecting. Detection can miss things, so always check.
